name: Netflix
description: Netflix Inc (NASDAQ: NFLX) is the world's largest subscription video-streaming service. India operations are not broken out separately in company filings.

stock.note: Netflix executed a 10-for-1 forward stock split effective Nov 17, 2025 — the ~$82 price reflects the split, not a decline from the pre-split ~$1,000+ level.

marketing_spend.derivation: Netflix's FY2025 10-K (SEC) attributes the rise in sales & marketing to 'a $222 million increase in marketing expenses'; global advertising expense was ~$1.78bn in 2024 (Netflix filings / Statista). India-specific spend is not disclosed; applying Netflix's ~6-7% global marketing-to-revenue ratio to an (undisclosed, sub-$1bn) India revenue base gives a modeled India figure of ~₹300-500 crore for FY25. The disclosed 10-K S&M line is used as the hard global anchor.
